purpose: Last 5 stable versions per browser for the generator's version pickers (meta.browserVersions). One entry per release train, newest first, in the exact string format used inside user-agent tokens.

sources.chromeAndroid/chromeIos: Google Chrome Version History API (versionhistory.googleapis.com), stable channel, newest build of each of the last 5 milestones, fetched 2026-11-25.
sources.firefoxAndroid: Mozilla product-details (product-details.mozilla.org): mobile_versions.json version=161.0 (2026-11-24) + firefox_history_stability_releases.json latest patch per train (160.0.1, 159.0.1, 158.0.1, 157.0.1).
sources.firefoxIos: Mozilla Firefox for iOS release notes (mozilla.org/firefox/ios): 161.0 (2026-11-23), 159.0 (2026-10-25), 158.0 (2026-10-11) verified on official notes pages; 160.1 / 160.0 from the App Store listing mirror (fileion, 2026-11-17).
sources.edgeAndroid/edgeIos: Microsoft Edge security release notes (learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnotes-security): entries titled 'for Android' / 'for Android and iOS' - 158.0.4370.33 (Nov 23), 157.0.4341.53 Android (Nov 11) / 157.0.4341.42 Android+iOS (Nov 9), 156.0.4314.56 (Nov 2), 155.0.4283.61 (Oct 19), 154.0.4258.38 (Sep 29). iOS 155/154 builds follow Microsoft's combined Android+iOS release pattern.
sources.operaAndroid: APKMirror latest Opera uploads (Opera Software ASA), Opera Browser Android stable: 104.1.5262.91393 (2026-11-18), 104.1.5262.91343, 104.0.5262.91259, 104.0.5258.91004, 103.3.5234.91185.
